name: Loop Feedback Improvements - Progress, Learnings, and Status Display
description: Enhance the ALL mode loop to provide richer feedback after each iteration. Currently YOLO mode trusts the AI to continue with speed, scale and quality - but the human loses visibility into what's happening. After each story completion, the loop should display: progress updates, any learned.md additions, and fade status output so the user can monitor quality without interrupting flow.

userStories.title: Display progress update after each iteration
userStories.description: As a developer running YOLO mode, I want to see a progress summary after each story completes so I know what was accomplished without reading the full Claude output
acceptanceCriteria: After STORY_DONE signal detected, loop displays iteration summary
Summary shows: 'USER STORY PASSED: US-XXX - [title]'
Summary shows: list of acceptance criteria that were accomplished
Summary shows: git commit message used
Summary shows: 'Progress: X of Y stories complete' from fade status
Output is visually distinct from Claude's output (e.g., boxed or colored)
Ends with 'Starting next iteration...' before continuing

userStories.title: Display learned.md changes after each iteration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see what was added to learned.md during each story so I can validate the AI is capturing useful knowledge
acceptanceCriteria: Loop detects changes to learned.md after each iteration
If learned.md was modified, display the diff or new entries
New learnings shown with clear heading: 'New Learnings Captured:'
If no changes to learned.md, display nothing (no noise)
Uses git diff or file comparison to detect changes

userStories.title: Display fade status after each iteration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see the updated work queue after each story completes so I can track overall PRD progress
acceptanceCriteria: Loop runs 'fade status' command after each STORY_DONE
fade status output displayed in terminal
Shows updated checkboxes reflecting just-completed story
Shows remaining stories in current PRD
Shows total progress (e.g., '3/7 stories complete')

userStories.title: Visual separator between iterations
userStories.description: As a developer watching the loop, I want clear visual breaks between iterations so the output is scannable
acceptanceCriteria: Iteration summary has clear visual separator (e.g., ═══════════)
Separator appears before summary block
Iteration number displayed: 'Iteration N Complete'
Easy to visually scan through multiple iterations in terminal history

userStories.title: Add --quiet flag to suppress iteration summaries
userStories.description: As a developer who trusts the process completely, I want the option to suppress iteration summaries for maximum speed
acceptanceCriteria: fade run --yolo --quiet skips iteration summary display
Still shows final completion message
Still captures all commits and learned.md updates
Default behavior (no --quiet) shows full summaries
Can combine: fade run --yolo --quiet

userStories.title: Update documentation for enhanced loop feedback
userStories.description: As a FADE user, I want the docs to explain what feedback I'll see in ALL/YOLO mode
acceptanceCriteria: README documents iteration summary feature
Documents what's shown: progress, learnings, status
Documents --quiet flag
Example output shown in docs
fade-project-description updated with ENH-008
